title: Frank Worrell's birth chart
metaDescription: Frank Worrell's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 9.1° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 9.1° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 9.1° of Leo is the Sun's exact seat — first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by the Sun in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 2.9° Virgo, Venus at 2.7° Cancer, Mars at 4.9° Pisces. Mercury in a earth sign reads as thought with its feet on the ground; Venus in a water sign reads as attraction that works by atmosphere; Mars in a water sign reads as effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Mercury to Venus, a sextile with 0.2° of slack. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, the Sun trine Jupiter at 1.0°, and Mercury opposition Mars at 2.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Uranus makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, four placements stand out. The Sun in Leo at 9.1° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mercury in Virgo at 2.9° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 10.1° is in domicile; Saturn in Libra at 26.5° is in exaltation. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: fire 4, water 4, earth 1, air 1 across the elements, and mutable 4, fixed 3, cardinal 3 across the modalities. Fire signs carry the scheme’s forward pressure: heat applied early, patience treated as a later skill. Mars, Jupiter and Uranus were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Leo for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.6° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 18.9°.
